description: This file defines the `GraphicsUnitDownwards` class, a subclass of `GraphicsUnitBase`. It contains a method `RenderSnippet` which demonstrates drawing operations using different graphics units (Point, Millimeter, Centimeter) in PDF pages, including lines, rectangles, and text.

classes.name: GraphicsUnitDownwards
classes.description: A class demonstrating graphical operations with different unit measurements in a PDF context.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Performs drawing operations on a PDF graphics object, showcasing different graphics units.
